home.title: Make your TikTok LIVE react.
home.lead: Tokio reads chat aloud, takes song requests, plays sounds and shows videos when someone follows or sends a gift, and drives the overlays in OBS, TikTok LIVE Studio or any streaming app that can show a web page.
home.meta: Free and open source, for Windows, macOS and Linux.
home.featuresText: Turn each feature on or off for the session.

tts.title: Text-to-speech
tts.text: Chat is read aloud as it comes in, with TikTok, Microsoft Edge or your system's voices.
tts.example:
{username} says {comment}
→ Lucia says hi from Lima!

music.title: Music requests
music.text: Viewers request songs from chat, played in Tokio's YouTube player or your Spotify app.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.text: A sound, an image or a video for follows, gifts, Super Fan events and more.

games.title: Games
games.text: Gifts, follows and chat spawn mobs and run commands in your Minecraft world.

overlays.title: Overlays
overlays.text: Install the official overlays or import your own, then add each with one link.

timer.title: Countdown timer
timer.text: A subathon clock on your stream that gifts, likes, follows and chat add time to.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.text: Separate settings for different streams, switched from the title bar.

home.overlaysTitle: One link per overlay, in any streaming app
home.overlaysText: Each overlay gets its own address on your computer.
apps: Any app with a browser source

steps.title: Install Tokio
steps.text: For Windows, macOS or Linux. It checks for updates on its own.

steps.title: Set it up
steps.text: Add your free Euler Stream key, then your voices, music, alerts and overlays.

steps.title: Prepare your stream
steps.text: Turn on the features you want, and add your overlays to OBS or TikTok LIVE Studio.

steps.title: Go live and connect
steps.text: Start your LIVE on TikTok, then connect with your @username.

home.ctaText: Tokio is free, open source and runs on your own computer.

download.title: Download
download.description: Download Tokio for Windows, macOS and Linux.
download.heading: Get Tokio
download.intro: A setup on Windows, a zip on macOS, an AppImage on Linux. Tokio checks for updates on its own.
download.windows: Run the setup: it installs Tokio for your user and opens it. Besides the TikTok and Edge voices, you also get the voices installed on Windows (SAPI and OneCore). Windows may show Windows protected your PC the first time, since Tokio isn't signed yet.
download.windowsMore: To run it anyway, choose More info, then Run anyway.
download.linux: Tokio comes as an AppImage. Make it executable with chmod +x (or in the file's properties) and run it. AppImages need FUSE.
download.mac: Unzip it and move Tokio to your Applications folder. macOS may block it the first time, since Tokio isn't notarized yet.
macMore: To open it anyway, right-click it in Finder and choose Open, or allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
When an update is out, Tokio opens its release page so you can download the new zip.
Not sure which Mac you have? Apple menu → About This Mac: "Apple M…" chips are Apple Silicon, "Intel" ones are Intel.

overlays.title: Overlays
overlays.description: The official overlays for Tokio, with a preview of each. Install them from Tokio and add them to OBS or TikTok LIVE Studio.
overlays.heading: Overlays
overlays.intro: Install them from the Overlays page in Tokio, then add each one's link to OBS or TikTok LIVE Studio. Updates keep your settings.
overlays.loadFailed: The list of overlays couldn't be loaded.
overlays.byHand: Prefer to do it by hand? Extract a zip and import the folder in Settings → Overlay library. Imported overlays don't get updates. The overlays are open source, in tokio-app/overlays.

about.title: About and license
about.description: Who makes Tokio, how it's licensed, the online services it uses and how your data is handled.
about.heading: About Tokio
about.intro: Tokio is a free, open-source desktop app that connects to your TikTok LIVE and reacts to it with text-to-speech, music requests, alerts, a countdown timer and overlays. It's made by Italo Alfaro and contributors and developed in the open on GitHub.
license: Tokio's source code is licensed under the MIT License. One file is an exception: src/main/services/tts/providers/edge/common/drm-v2.ts is derived from edge-tts and is licensed under the GNU LGPL v3.0.

The distributed application is under the same licenses. It connects to TikTok LIVE through @tokioapp/connector, which is MIT-licensed too, and the other components it includes keep their own licenses.
The full notices for every component are in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. The About page inside the app shows the same notices and the licenses of every package it ships.
about.source: The complete source code of every version is available at github.com/tokio-app/tokio. Each release is tagged (for example v0.1.0-alpha.3), so you can get the exact source of the version you installed. You may modify Tokio and share your changes under the terms of its licenses.
about.warranty: Tokio is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind, express or implied, including but not limited to the warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose and noninfringement. See the licenses for the full terms.
about.servicesText: Tokio talks to these online services. None of them is covered by Tokio's license. Each one is subject to its operator's terms and can stop working at any time.

services.name: TikTok
services.note: TikTok LIVE, through @tokioapp/connector, and TikTok's text-to-speech (the TikTok voices), when the user has added a TikTok session ID. Neither is an official public API.

services.name: TikTok TTS proxy
services.note: The TikTok voices when no session ID is set (tiktok-tts.weilnet.workers.dev). It gets the text of each message to read and its voice. It's run by a third party, not by TikTok or Tokio.

services.name: Euler Stream
services.note: Signs the connection to TikTok LIVE, with each user's own API key.

services.name: Microsoft
services.note: Edge's Read Aloud service (the Edge voices), which isn't an official public API.

services.name: GitHub
services.note: Update checks and downloads, from Tokio's releases, and the official overlays (their list, previews and downloads), from the releases of tokio-app/overlays.

services.name: MyInstants
services.note: Sound search and downloads for alerts, read from the public website rather than an official API. Its sounds are uploaded by its users and aren't covered by Tokio's license.

services.name: Lorem Picsum
services.note: Sample pictures (profile pictures, emotes, song covers) in overlay tests and previews.

privacy: Tokio runs on your computer and has no account. Your settings, profiles, sounds, images and videos are saved on your computer. To connect to TikTok LIVE you need your own Euler Stream account: Tokio saves its API key on your computer, encrypted when your system supports it, and sends it only to Euler Stream. A TikTok session ID, if you add one, is saved the same way and sent only to TikTok. Tokio sends requests only to the services listed above, when you use the features that need them, and checks GitHub for new versions to keep itself up to date.

This website is static and hosted on GitHub Pages. It sets no cookies and uses no analytics. GitHub may log technical data such as your IP address when you visit or download a file; see GitHub's privacy statement.
